title: Second craft near Skinwalker Ranch shoots into mountain
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Second craft near Skinwalker Ranch shoots into mountain, about an unknown time at near Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In another case near Skinwalker Ranch, he describes a similar craft doing the same thing, shooting straight into the mountain as if the stone was a doorway.

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels relays an account from the businessman Robert Bigelow about a craft seen near Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings. According to Bigelow, the craft shot straight into a mountain as if the stone were a doorway, much like another case he describes. If true, it would suggest these craft can pass through solid rock.
